title: Pending transfers
text: Before advising a customer about a pending transfer, check its live status with the transaction tool. A support policy is not proof that an individual transfer succeeded. Never promise a completion time without verified evidence.

title: Failed transfers
text: For a failed transfer, capture the transaction reference and check whether a reversal is recorded. If no reversal is visible, escalate to the payments team. This fictional policy gives no automatic refund deadline.

title: Lost or stolen card
text: For a lost or stolen card, direct the customer to the card controls in the app and recommend contacting the support team. This training assistant has no tool to freeze a card or move money.

title: Card purchase dispute
text: For an unrecognised card purchase or a duplicate merchant charge, collect the reference and escalate the dispute. Do not promise the outcome of an investigation.

title: Login and password recovery
text: For forgotten passwords or sign in problems, use the official password recovery flow. Never request a password, PIN or one-time code in a support chat.

title: Verification code delivery
text: If a login verification code has not arrived, check the registered contact channel and use the official retry flow. Never ask the customer to reveal the code to the assistant.

title: Internal risk escalation
text: Internal risk review criteria are restricted to the risk team. Support agents may escalate suspicious cases without exposing investigation details to customers.

title: Archived transfer policy
text: Old training policy: all pending transfers complete within five minutes. This document is archived and must not be retrieved as current guidance.
